name: JoAi: List Fulfillments

description.en: List all fulfillments for an order — shipment status, tracking, and fulfilled line items.
description.de: Alle Fulfillments einer Bestellung anzeigen — Versandstatus, Tracking und erfüllte Positionen.
description.fr: Liste toutes les expéditions d'une commande — statut, suivi et lignes expédiées.
description.es: Lista todos los envíos de un pedido — estado, seguimiento y líneas cumplidas.
description.it: Elenca tutte le evasioni di un ordine — stato spedizione, tracking e righe evase.
description.ro: Listează toate livrările unei comenzi — status, tracking și articole livrate.

bot: Use when the user wants to see fulfillment or shipping status for an order. If the order is unknown, list orders first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Order ID
inputs.bot: The order hash ID. If the user refers to an order by customer or item, list orders first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.fr: Slug d'équipe pour cette action. Par défaut l'équipe actuelle.
description.es: Slug del equipo para esta acción. Por defecto el equipo actual.
description.it: Slug del team per questa azione. Predefinito: team attuale.
description.ro: Slug-ul echipei pentru această acțiune. Implicit echipa curentă.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
